# Design Catalog — full agent briefing

Base: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app
Generated static JSON under /data/ (regenerated on npm run build).

## Purpose

Machine-readable + human-readable catalog of public AI design craft notes so agents can:

- Escape SaaS-landing / “vibe purple” priors (seed strings, ambitious briefs, anti-tells)
- Structure prompts (TC-EBC; thinking before prompt)
- Run critic loops on screenshots
- Enrich with image/video/motion and “make it alive”
- Deliver with cut + kill-list + hand-rewritten copy

Quiet Folio visual system: paper #FAF9F7 · ink #221C24 · studioInk #6F6470 · hairline #E8E3E8. No AI chrome.

## Fetch order

1. GET /data/index.json — overview, routes, anshuMapping, canonicalApps
2. Match the user problem to index.decisionPaths. Start with one technique; use stage or slug filters for other problems.
3. GET /data/techniques/{slug}.json for agentContract plus the existing procedure, examplePrompts, promptWhy, checklist, antiPatterns, pairsWellWith, workedExamples
4. GET /data/prompts.json when you need a flattened prompt library
5. Cite /data/sources.json; never invent paywalled quotes
6. Free craft libraries: /data/resources.json or /resources (transitions, shaders, easing, examples, textures—free first)
7. Shipaton 2025 winners catalog: /data/shipaton-2025.json or /shipaton-2025 (store previews; public sources; no endorsement)

## Anshu 1–8 ↔ Build Games Phase A

The mapping below preserves the original full-project workflow. It is optional for a bounded repair; do not run all eight techniques by default.

## Compact contract protocol

Read agentContract.useWhen and avoidWhen before implementing. Bring the named inputs, adapt the framework-neutral recipe, and produce the stated output. Add at most one companion for a distinct unmet need. compatibility.candidates are suggestions, not certified pairings. Resolve two techniques that alter the same role before applying either; never stack multiple attention effects on one target.

Collect observable evidence against acceptance and stateRequirements: responsive, accessibility, keyboard, reducedMotion, loading, empty, error, interruption and stateChange. Non-interface states may be N/A with a reason. An unchecked checklist is not a passed test. Report failures separately and stop when compatibility.stop is satisfied.

index.contractVersion identifies semantics; index.contentHash is a deterministic SHA-256 of exported content inputs; lastUpdated is the explicit editorial release date. Contract provenance is Catalog editorial synthesis, separate from source-author attribution. Public sources only; no paywalled reconstruction or endorsement.

Decision paths: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app/data/decision-paths.json
